entity_disambiguation.DOGE: Department of Government Efficiency — the federal government restructuring initiative led by Elon Musk. NOT the Dogecoin cryptocurrency. Track workforce reductions, agency restructuring, Schedule Policy/Career reclassification of federal employees.
entity_disambiguation.Board of Peace: Trump-created international organization for Gaza reconstruction via EO 14375, granted IOIA diplomatic immunity. Chairman: Trump (lifetime tenure). NOT a generic peace organization. Track membership, capital pledges, reconstruction contracts, legal challenges.
entity_disambiguation.Schedule Policy Career: Reclassification of ~50,000 federal career positions to at-will employment, replacing the legacy 'Schedule F' executive order. Implementation date was March 9, 2026. Published in Federal Register despite 94% public comment opposition.
entity_disambiguation.MGX: UAE sovereign technology investment fund chaired by Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan (UAE national security adviser). NOT a generic fund. Core positions: TikTok (15%), Stargate equity, World Liberty Financial (49% via Aryam Investment 1), G42 AI chips.
entity_disambiguation.1789 Capital: Investment vehicle founded by Omeed Malik. Dual symbolism: 1789 = US Constitution year AND Saudi territorial expansion (Saud bin Abdulaziz). Investments: Tucker Carlson Network, Anduril, Neuralink, xAI, SpaceX, Cerebras. Functions as semiotic bridge between Gulf capital, media narrative, and defense tech.
entity_disambiguation.QXO: Public holding company. Affinity Partners (Kushner) sole public holding. Apollo $3B credit pipeline. Completed $11B Beacon Roofing acquisition. Targeting $50B annual revenue via acquisitions.
entity_disambiguation.Affinity Partners: Jared Kushner's investment firm. $5.4B AUM including $2B from Saudi PIF. Sole public holding: QXO. Kushner serves as Board of Peace Senior Adviser.
entity_disambiguation.Savvy Games: Saudi PIF subsidiary for gaming investments. Owns Scopely, Niantic, ESL FACEIT, SNK. Take-Two shares transferred from PIF to Savvy Games (Q4 2025).
entity_disambiguation.Sanabil Investments: Saudi PIF subsidiary investing in 40+ US VC/PE firms including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Founders Fund, and Valar Ventures. Pipeline for indirect Gulf capital deployment into US tech ecosystem.
entity_disambiguation.Operation Epic Fury: US-Israel military operation against Iran that began February 28, 2026. Also referred to as 'Lion's Roar' by Israel. Resulted in destruction of Iran nuclear and military infrastructure.
entity_disambiguation.CRINK: Analytical framework for China-Russia-Iran-North Korea coordination bloc. Not an official organization. Used to track emergent alignment patterns among these four nations.
entity_disambiguation.Strait of Hormuz: Critical oil shipping chokepoint between Iran and UAE/Oman. Closure during Iran war caused ~20% oil price increase. Track shipping disruptions, mine-laying operations, US Navy mine-clearing.

framework_context: The Regulated Friction Project tracks correlations between high-visibility friction events (document releases, scandals, media cycles) and institutional compliance events (policy shifts, financial moves, regulatory changes), with a documented 7-day median lag pattern (r=0.62, p<0.001, n=28). IMPORTANT: 'DOGE' refers to the Department of Government Efficiency (federal restructuring), NOT Dogecoin cryptocurrency. 'Board of Peace' is a specific Trump-created international organization for Gaza. All entities should be interpreted in their geopolitical/institutional context, not their consumer/retail context.
